title: AC1018 selected TABLE source observation writer revalidation
scope: Writer lifecycle freshness checks for opt-in verified XRECORD/TABLE candidate observations and selected STYLE/LTYPE resource observations.

implementation.staging: dx_iface::writeLTypes and writeTextstyles recheck the selected observation bundle before resource-table staging; writeObjects rechecks before OBJECTS staging.
implementation.finalization: dx_iface::finalizeDxfWrite rechecks the same bundle before final output publication.
implementation.selection: The check verifies the exact selected XRECORD handles and source generation, then revalidates any selected TABLE candidates and selected STYLE/LTYPE resource observations.
implementation.semantics: This is stale-source refusal only. It does not authorize raw replay, typed TABLE output, graph closure, or support claims.

control.source: Locally authored AC1018 generated DWG created and removed by the focused test.
assertions: A complete selected TABLE candidate bundle passes the shared revalidation predicate used by both writer boundaries.
Mutation of the selected TABLEGEOMETRY frame causes both the source query and shared revalidation predicate to refuse.
Restoring the frame permits the same adapter to pass again.
Transplanting the candidate snapshot into a different import generation is refused.
control.result: PASS; the generated control calls the shared predicate directly rather than executing a full DXF export.

validation.result: PASS: each focused CTest 1/1; diff check clean. The tests cover the shared revalidation predicate and LTYPE ticket behavior; they do not execute a complete DXF export through the new staging callbacks.

limitations: No TABLE/DATATABLE/TABLEGEOMETRY output is enabled by this check.
No physical or generated DWG/DXF fixture is committed.
Recursive resource closure, native semantics, and whole-source output remain open.
